What is Spain Daily?

Spain moves fast. Every morning we read the Spanish press cover to cover and hand you only the news that affects your life.

  • What you get A daily Spain news digest: short summaries in plain English, zero clickbait.
  • What it covers Rents, taxes, visas, jobs and the other stories that change daily life here.
  • Who it's for People who live in Spain, are planning the move or are watching from afar.

Which Spanish newspapers do we read?

Spain Daily is a newsletter, not a newspaper. We do not report the news ourselves: every day we aggregate the Spanish press, translate and summarize the stories in English, and link each one to its source.

  • El País
  • El Mundo
  • La Vanguardia
  • Cinco Días
  • Expansión
  • elDiario.es
  • El Confidencial
  • 20 Minutos
  • Heraldo
  • Diario Sur
  • Europa Press agency

International news makes the cut only when it directly affects Spain. It is Spanish news in English, built for the English-language reader who wants the Spanish press without reading it in Spanish.

How it works

  1. We aggregate the Spanish press National dailies, wires and regional titles. We pick what affects your life: rents, taxes, visas, jobs.
  2. We summarize in plain English Short factual briefs with links to the sources, AI-assisted and checked by the editor before every send.
  3. You read it in 5 minutes In your inbox around 08:00 Madrid time, seven days a week.

Questions, answered

The short version of what readers ask us most. Anything else? Write to us.

Where can I read Spanish news in English?

On Spain Daily: every morning we publish a free edition with Spain's top stories in plain English, online and by email. Each item links to the original Spanish source, so you can read the full article if you want to.

Is Spain Daily a newspaper or a newsletter?

Spain Daily is a newsletter, not a newspaper. We do not do original reporting: we aggregate Spanish outlets, then translate and summarize their stories in English and link to each source. The summaries are AI-assisted and checked by an editor before every send.

Which Spanish newspapers does Spain Daily summarize?

Spain Daily reads national and regional Spanish media: El País, Cinco Días, El Mundo, La Vanguardia, elDiario.es, El Confidencial, 20 Minutos, Heraldo, Diario Sur and Expansión, plus the Europa Press agency. International news is included only when it directly affects Spain. Every story shows its source.

Can Spain Daily replace an English-language newspaper about Spain?

No, it is meant to sit alongside one. Spain Daily is a five-minute daily briefing with links to the original reporting, so you get the headlines on rents, taxes, visas and jobs fast and can go deeper in the source or in an English-language outlet.

What is a good English-language newsletter about Spain?

Spain Daily is a free English-language newsletter about Spain: one email a day, around 08:00 Madrid time, seven days a week, with a five-minute read on the news that affects life in Spain. You can try it by reading the latest edition online before you subscribe.

What is Spanified?

Spanified is a free newsletter that summarizes the most important news from Spain in plain English — rents, taxes, visas, jobs and everyday life.

How often does the digest arrive?

Every morning, seven days a week. Five minutes with your coffee and you're up to speed.

Is it really free?

Yes — free forever. No paywall, no trial, just the news.

What language is it in?

The summaries are written in clear English, based on the Spanish press we read cover to cover each morning.

Where can I read past editions?

Every edition stays online in the archive — browse by date or search the whole history.
